_why: Registers whose own content reaches into the band the renderer reserves for the burned caption, or past the action-safe border. Measured by scripts/shot_still_qa.py on a standalone still of each register at its demo defaults. Some are legitimately FULL-BLEED — a generative field's ground IS the frame, and its own texture counts as ink here — but several put a readable ELEMENT there: a strapline, a ticker row, a panel edge. This file exists so the debt is named rather than rediscovered, and tests/test_remotion.py asserts the list may SHRINK and never GROW.
_measured_against: band = captionBand(W,H) at 1920x1080 = 227px; thresholds shot_still_qa CAPTION_FRAC_ERR / EDGE_FRAC_ERR
_measured_at: the frame useT() calls SETTLED (REDUCED_MOTION_T), derived per register from its own exported DURATION — the frame every visual gate reads
